scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n database,shared,api,web -c magenta,yellow,blue,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=@tradel/database" "npm run dev --workspace=@tradel/shared" "npm run start:dev --workspace=@tradel/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@tradel/web"
scripts.dev:api: concurrently -k -n database,shared,api -c magenta,yellow,blue "npm run dev --workspace=@tradel/database" "npm run dev --workspace=@tradel/shared" "npm run start:dev --workspace=@tradel/api"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n shared,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=@tradel/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@tradel/web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:database && npm run build:shared
